mechanism: Propafenone is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase progesterone concentrations, while progesterone can induce CYP3A4 potentially reducing propafenone levels, creating bidirectional interaction.
action: Monitor cardiac rhythm and propafenone efficacy; consider ECG monitoring and adjust propafenone dose if needed; counsel on breakthrough bleeding or progesterone efficacy changes.
